# DIFL — Dante Institute of Foreign Languages, Jaipur

> Foreign language institute in Jaipur, founded in 1970 by Late Dr. V K Sharma. DIFL teaches 12 languages and uses its TTP (Thought Translation Process) approach to make the learner's familiar language a structured bridge to expression. Online, offline and hybrid classes are available.

Languages taught: French, Japanese, German, Spanish, Chinese (Mandarin), Korean, Arabic, Italian, Russian, English, Thai, and Hindi for foreigners.

Exam preparation: JLPT, DELF/DALF, TEF Canada, TCF Canada, Goethe, DELE, SIELE, HSK, TOPIK, EPS-TOPIK, IELTS, TOEFL, OET.

Language preparation and general guidance related to Ausbildung Germany, MEXT Japan, Campus France, GKS Korea, TITP/SSW Japan and Canadian French-language pathways. Official institutions decide admission, employment, scholarship and visa outcomes.

## Language courses

- [French](https://mydifl.com/learn-french/): DELF, DALF, TEF Canada, TCF Canada
- [Japanese](https://mydifl.com/learn-japanese/): JLPT N5–N1; preparation relevant to eligible TITP/SSW routes, with official eligibility controlling
- [German](https://mydifl.com/learn-german/): Goethe, telc and TestDaF preparation; confirm the currently offered level and the official Ausbildung requirements
- [Spanish](https://mydifl.com/learn-spanish/): DELE, SIELE
- [Korean](https://mydifl.com/learn-korean-language/): TOPIK, EPS-TOPIK, GKS
- [Chinese Mandarin](https://mydifl.com/learn-mandarin-chinese/): HSK 1–6, HSKK
- [Arabic](https://mydifl.com/learn-arabic/): MSA, script, practical communication and Gulf-dialect basics
- [Italian](https://mydifl.com/learn-italian-language/): PLIDA, CILS
- [Russian](https://mydifl.com/learn-russian-language/): TORFL
- [English](https://mydifl.com/learn-english/): IELTS, TOEFL, OET
- [Thai](https://mydifl.com/learn-thai-language/)
- [Hindi for foreigners](https://mydifl.com/learn-hindi-language/)

## Teaching methodology — TTP (Thought Translation Process)

DIFL's teaching approach: instead of relying only on memorized textbook sentences, learners practise expressing their own thoughts through an explicit grammar bridge and live conversion drills. Full explanation: https://mydifl.com/blog/ttp-method/
